SwingTrade · ResearchA5 · 2026-05-09

Catalyst-Conditional Trade Decomposition

Pure technical features failed to predict +2% movers (mover_predictor v1+v2, AUC 0.546). This note tests whether catalyst-adjacent slicing surfaces hidden alpha buckets — without ML, just Wilson 95% CIs across all 2N dimension combinations.
Threshold: n≥20 · Wilson LB≥40% · PF≥1.3

§ 2 · Data Quality Notes

What we have, and what we don't

⚠ Critical data gap

The 384-trade 750d backtest trade record carries no per-trade catalyst metadata. Each trade has only: ticker, entry_date, exit_date, entry_price, exit_price, stop_price, position_size, pnl_pct, pnl_dollar, exit_reason, days_held, setup_type, score, verdict, win, trail_activated, highest_price. There are no catalyst_tags, news_sentiment_score, uoa, insider_data, analyst, or earnings fields.

The 1,106-entry signal_log has richer metadata (setup_family, entry_quality, conviction_label, regime_name, tail_filter_demoted, profile) but its raw_json blobs are uniformly empty (0/1106 populated). It also does not log catalyst_tags, news scores, UOA flags, insider clusters, analyst upgrades, or earnings proximity.

The two corpora overlap by exactly 1 trade (different windows: backtest 2023-08-04 → 2026-04-30, signal_log 2026-04-13 → 2026-05-08). Cross-enrichment is therefore impossible.

What this script substitutes

  • Backtest corpus: uses setup_type (6 distinct values) as a coarse catalyst-style proxy, plus a score high/mid band split. These are the only entry-time signals captured in the trade record.
  • Signal-log corpus: uses setup_family, strategy, entry_quality, conviction_label, regime_name, and tail_filter_demoted as catalyst-adjacent dimensions.
  • True catalyst conditioning (earnings ±5d, insider cluster 30d, UOA, analyst upgrade ±14d, news sentiment burst) requires a one-line patch to backtest.py and signal_tracker.py to persist catalyst_tags + news_sentiment_score.score + tier1_signals.signals into the trade record at entry time. Until that ships, this analysis is a coarse approximation.

§ 5 · Recommended next steps

To do this analysis properly

  • Fix #1 (15 min): Patch backtest.py and signal_tracker.py::log_signal() to persist catalyst_tags, catalyst_tier, news_sentiment_score.score, tier1_signals.signals, insider_data.sentiment, uoa.alerts, earnings.days_to_earnings, and analyst.upside_pct into the trade record at entry time. These are all already computed pre-scoring in analysis.py; they just aren't being saved.
  • Fix #2 (30 min): Re-run the 750d backtest. Because catalyst metadata is computed per-day from last_bundle.json-equivalent state, you'd need to either (a) snapshot daily bundles during backtest (cheap, just write to cache/backtest_bundles/<date>.json) or (b) point-in-time replay catalyst computation at each trade's entry_date.
  • Fix #3 (1 hr): Re-run this script. With real catalyst flags, the 25=32 base combinations + interactions become statistically meaningful.
  • Decision rule for live: if any combination clears n≥30, Wilson LB≥55%, PF≥1.7 — promote it as a hard gate (require_catalyst_combo) in decision_engine.py.
